# TextFieldText <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Text Areas](BlitzPlus-Text-Areas)

```blitzbasic
TextFieldText:String textfield:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `textfield` | In | Int32 | required | Handle of a text field. |

**Returns:** The text in the field, even for a password field.

_Not documented yet._
